s.note: the summer swim at the quarry
s.how: Whisk 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp red wine vinegar, 1 tsp dried oregano, salt and pepper. Split 4 long soft rolls and drizzle the insides with half the dressing. Layer each with 3 slices provolone, 4 slices salami and 3 slices leg ham. Top with shredded iceberg, sliced tomato, red onion and pickled peppers, drizzle with the rest of the dressing and close. Wrap each tightly in baking paper and halve.
Roast 500g cherry tomatoes on the vine at 200C for 10 minutes with olive oil and thyme. Spread 250g whipped ricotta over toasted sourdough and top with the tomatoes. You'll float too.

m.note: a summer in a small Maine town
m.how: Chop 400g cooked lobster or prawn meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a diced celery stick and chives. Butter and toast the cut sides of 4 hot dog buns and pile the filling in.

w.how: Crumble a 500g vanilla cake into 100g cream cheese beaten with 50g icing sugar. Roll into 16 balls, push in lollipop sticks and chill. Dip in 300g melted red candy melts and tie a bit of string to each like a balloon.

d.how: Simmer 250g hulled strawberries with 150g caster sugar and 150ml water for 5 minutes, crush and strain to a syrup, then cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug, add the syrup and stir. Add plenty of ice, sliced strawberries and lemon wheels, then top with 1 litre chilled soda water and a few mint leaves.
